ValidationRule.description: Closing won requires EOI Amount, Token Amount, and Primary Unit to all be populated. Prevents premature close-won without financial commitment.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed Won (Booked)'), OR( ISBLANK(EOI_Amount__c), ISBLANK(Token_Amount__c), ISBLANK(Primary_Unit__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: EOI Amount, Token Amount, and Primary Unit are all required to close won.
